clue.text: Detailed zoo rhino's blurred range of vision

indicators.note: a blurred image has its parts jumbled, so the letters are rearranged
de-tailed: the word zoo loses its tail, its last letter

parts.note: the possessive 's adds no letter; rhino is taken as written

explanation.surface: A zoo rhinoceros is said to have poor, fuzzy eyesight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detailed' cuts ZOO to ZO; 'blurred' rearranges ZO plus RHINO.
explanation.definitionFit: The horizon is the limit of what can be seen, the extent of one's sight.

clue.text: Met requirements with reservations

definitions.meaning: someone who has met the requirements for a post is certified as fit for it
a statement made with reservations is limited or hedged

explanation.surface: Someone passed the test, but only grudgingly.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both suitably trained or eligible and modified by conditions or limits.

clue.text: Stand by as one says mass

indicators.note: what one says is heard rather than seen, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: to stand by is to wait

explanation.surface: Someone is told to wait in the wings while another announces a quantity.
explanation.definitionFit: In everyday use heaviness and mass are treated as synonyms.

clue.text: Don Juan's Spanish house beside river flowing west

parts.note: casa is Spanish for house

indicators.note: in an across clue westward runs right to left, so the river's name is read backwards

parts.note: the Avon is a river in England

explanation.surface: A legendary seducer owns a Spanish house by a westward-flowing river.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is': Don Juan is the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Both names are bywords for a womaniser; Casanova was a real Venetian lover, Don Juan a fictional one.

clue.text: Confer after City unexpectedly perform successfully

indicators.note: something done unexpectedly is out of the expected order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A football commentator's line about a team doing well after conferring with City.
explanation.definitionFit: To put a plan into action and see it through is to execute or accomplish it.

clue.text: One directs autograph to be put on mail

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece put on another sits above it

parts.note: an autograph is a signature, a sign
post is the mail

explanation.surface: Someone tells a fan to stick their autograph on the post.
explanation.definitionFit: A roadside pointer gives directions to travellers, so it is something that directs.

clue.text: Material from US city and European capital cut by 50%

parts.note: NY is New York

indicators.note: half of the capital's six letters are lopped off, leaving the front three

parts.note: London is the capital of the UK

explanation.surface: Fabric sourced from New York and a capital, at half price.
explanation.definitionFit: A synthetic polymer used as a fabric for stockings and clothing.

clue.text: Old soldier chopped tree in front

indicators.note: the jumbled tree sits inside the word for front

parts.note: the van, short for vanguard, is the front

indicators.note: a chopped-up tree is in pieces, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An old soldier cut down a tree at the front of the house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'front' looks like a place but is the vanguard, the leading part of an army; 'chopped' yields ETER.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-serving or former member of the armed forces.

clue.text: Very old Scottish chimney shown by English book

parts.note: lum is the Scots word for a chimney

explanation.surface: An antique Scots chimney stands beside an English one.
explanation.walkthrough: LUM is Scots dialect for a chimney.
explanation.definitionFit: A volume is one bound book, often one of a set.

clue.text: Break a rule — get control

indicators.note: breaking something smashes it into pieces, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A rebel's motto: flout the rules to seize power.
explanation.definitionFit: To govern or keep in order by rules is to manage and direct it.

clue.text: One from the country having drink after 6.50

indicators.note: the beer comes after the numerals

parts.note: 6 is VI and 50 is L in Roman numerals
lager is a drink, a beer

explanation.surface: A countryman has a pint after ten to seven.
explanation.walkthrough: 6.50 is read as Roman numerals, VI then L.
explanation.definitionFit: A rural inhabitant lives in a small settlement in the countryside.

clue.text: Write short lines about upper-class poverty

indicators.note: the writing and the lines go round the class letter

parts.note: to pen is to write
RY is short for railway, a set of lines
U denotes upper-class

explanation.surface: A poet dashes off brief verses on genteel destitution.
explanation.definitionFit: Penury is extreme want, a state of great need.

clue.text: Rip off iron on the wagon? One gets stuff to throw at people!

parts.note: to rip someone off is to con them
Fe is the chemical symbol for iron
on the wagon means teetotal, abbreviated TT
one is I in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A cheating, teetotal type ends up as a target at a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the wagon' is an idiom for abstaining from alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper scraps are tossed over a bride and groom at weddings.

clue.text: Snuggling in home by the heather

parts.note: a nest is a bird's home
ling is common heather

explanation.surface: Cuddling up at home among the heather.
explanation.definitionFit: Settling cosily against something is to cuddle up close.

clue.text: Yearns to hold man in underwear

indicators.note: the word for yearns contains the name

parts.note: to yearn is to long; he longs
John is a man's name

explanation.surface: Someone pines to embrace a man in his smalls.
explanation.definitionFit: Full-length thermal underpants worn in cold weather.

clue.text: Amazing result of strike

definitions.meaning: used as an adjective, stunning or brilliant
a punch that floors a boxer for the count ends the bout

explanation.surface: An impressive outcome from a single blow.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a stunner and the ending of a fight by a decisive blow.

clue.text: Admirer drunk and shot in dance

parts.note: an admirer is a fan

indicators.note: drunk means reeling, so the letters of and are rearranged

parts.note: a shot is a go, a try

explanation.surface: A fan, tipsy, takes a turn on the dance floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A lively Spanish dance for couples, in triple time.

clue.text: Pitch up, being restrained by excellent mum in scrap

indicators.note: the turned word is held inside the word for excellent

parts.note: A1 means excellent, with the 1 read as the letter I

indicators.note: in a down clue going up reads the word from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: to lob is to pitch or toss
mum, as in keep mum, means silence: SH

explanation.surface: A fight breaks out as a fine mother stops a ball being thrown.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'up' reads a word bottom to top, giving BOL; 'mum' is the call for silence, as in 'keep mum'.
explanation.definitionFit: To do away with a law or practice is to get rid of it entirely.

clue.text: Dazed non-fliers in resting place

indicators.note: the birds go inside the bed

parts.note: a bed is somewhere to rest
emus are flightless birds

explanation.surface: Flightless birds lie stunned in their beds.
explanation.definitionFit: Puzzled or bewildered, unable to think clearly.

clue.text: Reg struggling to get in before time for tea

indicators.note: the jumbled name goes inside the word for before time

parts.note: early means ahead of time

indicators.note: struggling suggests flailing about, so the letters of Reg are rearranged

explanation.surface: Reg battles to arrive ahead of schedule for teatime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'time for tea' reads as a deadline, but 'before time' is the container and 'tea' alone the definition; 'struggling' gives GRE.
explanation.definitionFit: A black blend flavoured with bergamot oil, a popular brew.

clue.text: Republics with no local souvenirs

indicators.note: the word Republics is left with no pub in it

parts.note: a local is one's neighbourhood pub

explanation.surface: Mementoes from countries where you cannot find a bar.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'local' is British slang for one's regular pub.
explanation.definitionFit: Mementoes or keepsakes from the past are remnants kept for memory.

clue.text: Universal joint used in medico's microprocessor

indicators.note: the two words are joined and the answer is found inside them

explanation.surface: A universal joint forms part of a doctor's computer chip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Universal joint' looks like one mechanical term; it splits into definition and indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to the universe or cosmos, so vast and all-embracing.

clue.text: Aggressively male Chinese leader touring Switzerland

indicators.note: the leader's name goes round the country code

parts.note: Mao Zedong led communist China
CH is the international code for Switzerland

explanation.surface: A swaggering Chinese leader on a Swiss tour.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing an exaggerated, aggressive masculinity.

clue.text: Further monitoring of hit-maker's next record

definitions.meaning: continued checking after an initial action, as after a medical visit
a band's successor to a hit single

explanation.surface: A pop star's next single gets checked once more.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a subsequent check-up and a sequel to a success.

clue.text: Reveal record waste

parts.note: a disc is a record
to waste a chance is to lose it

explanation.surface: Expose a rubbish vinyl album.
explanation.definitionFit: To make known something that was hidden or secret.

clue.text: Many aboard worry it's bulging outwards

parts.note: C is 100 in Roman numerals, so many
aboard means on
to vex is to worry or annoy

explanation.surface: A crowd on a ship fret that the hull is bulging.
explanation.definitionFit: Curved outward like the outside of a sphere, the opposite of concave.

clue.text: Current monitor coming from north-east, not north

indicators.note: the answer is made from the letters of north-east, worked into a new order

explanation.surface: An electrical gauge arriving from the north-east.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove N ('not north') from NORTHEAST and rearrange ORTHEAST.
explanation.definitionFit: A variable resistor regulates the strength of an electric current.
